title: Raymond Larsen v. Pacific Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC unanimously approved the chair and secretary's finding that Larsen's appeal was administratively out of order under BCO 42-2 because he had not submitted to a regular trial.
first_summary: A member sought to appeal a Session judgment deposing him for contumacy after he failed to appear for trial. The SJC unanimously found the appeal administratively out of order because BCO 42-2 permits an appeal only by a person who submitted to a regular trial. The notice does not review the merits of the deposition.
